title: Ship-Now Availability across Tailwise Autoship Programs
content:
A ship-now shipment is an extra, on-demand shipment the customer triggers on a Tailwise Autoship subscription outside its regular schedule. Whether a program offers it, and how long after the last charged shipment it may be processed, is set per program.

| Program | Customer may trigger a ship-now shipment | Minimum calendar days since the subscription's last charged shipment |
|---|---|---|
| Autoship Everyday | Yes | 3 |
| Autoship Litter & Bulk | Yes | 3 |
| Autoship Fresh & Frozen | Yes | 7 |
| Autoship Custom Meal Plan | No | 0 |
| Autoship Pharmacy | Yes | 21 |
| Autoship Compounded Pharmacy | No | 0 |

On the two programs that do not offer ship-now (Autoship Custom Meal Plan and Autoship Compounded Pharmacy) the day count reads 0 and has no use.

### Day counts on both sides (hypothetical)

- Autoship Pharmacy, last charged shipment 21 calendar days before the request: the minimum is reached.
- Autoship Pharmacy, last charged shipment 20 calendar days before the request: the minimum is not reached.
- Autoship Fresh & Frozen, last charged shipment 7 calendar days before the request: the minimum is reached; at 6 days it is not.
